This '''[[Starship/Legends|starship]] dealer''' was a [[Vultan]] and had a base of operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nak Shimor]]. In [[3999 BBY]], the Vultan sold the ship ''[[Lightside Explorer]]'' to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Andur Sunrider]].
